function.description: Updates the inventory count for a specific product by adding or subtracting from the current stock level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_id.description: The unique identifier for the product whose stock is being updated.

change_type.description: Specifies whether the inventory is being increased or decreased.

quantity.description: The amount by which the inventory level is to be changed, expressed in units of the product.

reason.description: Optional explanation for the inventory adjustment.

**Translation:** “Web Master”

### Why it appears as *“וואב מאכסטו”*

When someone types **“web master”** on a computer that’s accidentally set to the Hebrew keyboard layout, the keystrokes generate Hebrew letters instead of Latin ones.  
Using the standard Israeli‑keyboard mapping:

| English key | Hebrew letter |
|-------------|---------------|
| w           | ו             |
| e           | ה             |
| b           | ב             |
|   …         |               |

Applying this mapping to the entire phrase “web master” results in the Hebrew-looking string **״וואב מאכסטו״**, even though it carries no semantic value in Hebrew—it’s simply a visual artifact caused by the wrong keyboard setting.

So, the proper interpretation in English is **“web master.”**
